plan.notes: Transcribed from the official IVC 'All Program Maps' map 'Electronic Technology, AS' (badges: AS-GE, 2 Years Full-Time), ivc.edu. GE pattern: AS-GE. The map is published as a sample academic plan; semesters, courses, and unit values transcribed exactly as published. Credit ranges encoded at source lower bound per collector rule (documented per slot). Student-choice slots (GE areas, electives, major-list courses, option lists) encoded as choice slots per the official map. The map states no course prerequisites.
